attacks.name: Battle-Axe
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: The Executioner
steps: If the defender has the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition, this character may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Storm Giant Strength
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Right-Hand Man
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character targets another allied character with an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of |!range| and LOS.

superPowers.name: Aggressive
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may Advance |!range_small| Toward the attacking character.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
